product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides an AI-powered employee-experience platform for enterprise organizations and HR/people leaders to gather employee feedback, analyze workforce insights, and turn them into coaching, learning, and actions that improve the workplace.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its offering as an AI-powered employee experience and people-activation platform.

pricing_page.notes: The public site offers contact/sales-demo links and a contact form, but no public pricing page or prices.

named_customers.notes: These organizations appear as customers in Perceptyx customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Perceptyx in the 201–500 employee band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Temecula, California as the company headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists the company as founded in 2003.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index contains research, employee-experience, product/news, and marketing content, but no two qualifying engineering-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: Perceptyx links a public developer portal with guides and documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers job board showed zero open positions when checked.

model_provider.notes: Perceptyx's AI model governance document names OpenAI and these models as powering its AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, and claims GDPR adherence; it does not name HIPAA or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Perceptyx announced a strategic TCV investment on 2019-08-12, its first outside investment; the amount was not disclosed. The schema requires a numeric amount, so 0 is a placeholder for undisclosed, not a claim that the round was $0.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified funding round was announced in August 2019, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Perceptyx Enterprise Account Executive listing showed a recent posting and an application option. A separate Built In listing was removed on November 5, 2026, so this answer relies on the recent LinkedIn listing.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced the launch of Develop on 2026-05-14, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mary Poppen joined as Chief Customer Officer in June 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations page names HRIS/HCM, ATS, analytics, collaboration, and AI products, but no CRM or sales/marketing platform such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
